body:
DESIGN ANALYSIS for the scout's RecallSignature findings 2 and 3, which I deliberately did NOT implement in d4443ff because they redefine what the numbers MEAN rather than whether they abstain. No code, no claim; this is so whoever implements has a settled shape and does not have to invent denominators at dawn.

THE UNIFYING PRINCIPLE I WOULD LIKE RATIFIED, because all four sub-cases are one thing: WHEN A QUANTITY IS A RATIO CONDITIONED ON SOME MASS, THAT MASS IS NOT A NUISANCE - IT IS THE COVERAGE. Renormalizing by it hides how little the number rests on; weighting by it preserves that; and when it is zero there is no number at all. Findings 2 and 3 are four instances of dividing the conditioning mass away and then presenting the residue as a full-strength claim.

FINDING 2a - THE 0.5 CLIFF (signature.scala:98-107). A unit enters the fidelity mean only when sourceMass > externalMass. At 0.51 it contributes its MAP anchor's fidelity at FULL weight; at 0.49 it contributes nothing at all. An arbitrarily small change in mass flips a unit between total inclusion and total exclusion, which is exactly the arbitrary determinacy the estimand contract forbids. Options: (a) mass-weighted fidelity - each unit contributes in proportion to its source mass, cliff gone; (b) keep the threshold and publish the count of units that passed as coverage; (c) both. I recommend (c), value mass-weighted AND coverage reported.

FINDING 2b - MAP-ONLY ASSESSMENT. Fidelity assesses only the MAP anchor and mode, so a unit at 0.51 on anchor A and 0.49 on B is scored as though A were certain. The distribution we worked hard to compute is discarded at the last step. Recommendation: expectation over the anchor distribution, not the argmax. This is the same argument as the interview module's hard-count rules, one module over.

FINDING 3a - COMPRESSION (signature.scala:117-123). A unit with no source mass contributes 0.0 to the mean - and 0.0 means MAXIMALLY FINE-GRAINED, level zero. A unit we could not place at all is published as the most specific possible recall. Worse than a wrong number: it is a confident claim in the flattering direction. And when source mass is tiny but nonzero, dividing by it renormalizes: 0.01 of mass sitting at the top level yields compression 1.0, counted equally with a fully-placed unit. Recommendation: Option[Double], None when no unit has source mass; per-unit contributions weighted by that unit's source mass rather than each unit counting equally after renormalization.

FINDING 3b - SEMANTIC FLOW COHERENCE (signature.scala:188). `if coherence.isEmpty then 1.0` - PERFECT coherence from no steps. This is the identical defect to the chronology default I just fixed in d4443ff, in the next function, and I missed it because I was matching on `.getOrElse` rather than on the shape. Recommendation: Option[Double], None when no source-to-source step exists; steps weighted by their source-to-source mass.

THE PART THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE FORMULAE. All of these CHANGE THE ESTIMAND. `fidelity` after a mass-weighting fix is not the same quantity as `fidelity` before it, and anyone holding a number from tonight cannot compare it to a number from tomorrow. Per ADR 0003 the redefinition must be DECLARED, not silent. Concretely I would want: a version marker on RecallSignature (it already has SignatureProjection.version - the signature itself has none), or renamed fields, so that the change is visible at the point of use rather than discoverable only by reading a commit. Otherwise we will have fixed the honesty of the number and broken the honesty of its history.

WHAT I AM NOT RECOMMENDING: doing 2 and 3 in one commit with the version marker as an afterthought. I would sequence it as (i) the version marker alone, cheap and uncontroversial, then (ii) 2 and 3 against a signature that can already say which definition it is.

Chief: happy to implement whichever of this you ratify, or to hand it to the scout who found it and has the better sample. I have no attachment to being the one who writes it - I would rather the shape be right.
